overall_notes: Play-next is the part that already works: numbered roster, huge banked-XP figure, and a plain sentence that says hearth then play Le Nette. Default theme is a credible WoW frame, and the character lines are the delight. It is not shippable for this user yet. ElvUI mode still looks like the ornate default window with a blue Compact button, not his thin near-black Gatewood panels, cream/gold type and blue enamel actions. Orange rest state muddies into bronze chrome, compact UI is three disconnected strips, and secondary gray text fails on the dark fill.
